wget -S -O pycdlib.json https://pypi.org/pypi/pycdlib/json 2>&1 | head -40
ls -l

set -e

        print(f['url']); break

cat url.txt

cd /workspace
PYTHONPATH=/workspace/dl/pycdlib.whl python3 - <<'PY'
import pycdlib
iso=pycdlib.PyCdlib(); iso.open('/workspace/alpine.iso')
print('rockridge', iso.has_rock_ridge, 'joliet', iso.has_joliet)
def walk(path, depth=0):
    if depth>2: return
    for c in iso.list_children(iso_path=path):
        n=c.file_identifier().decode(errors='replace')
        if n in ('.','..'): continue
        full=(path.rstrip('/')+'/'+n)
        print('  '*depth + n + ('/' if c.is_dir() else f'  [{c.get_data_length()}]'))
        if c.is_dir(): walk(full, depth+1)
walk('/')
iso.close()
PY

        rr=None

            rr='ERR:'+str(e)

iso.close()

set -e
